source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Huygens' principle (PDF 46-47).

blocks.text: Huygens ka usool, jo pehli dafa Dutch scientist Christiaan Huygens ne bayan kiya, aik geometrical tareeqa hai jis se kisi lamhe wavefront ki maloom shakal se baad ke waqt us ki shakal nikali jati hai. Huygens ne farz kiya ke wavefront ka har nuqta secondary wavelets ka source samjha ja sakta hai jo lehar ki raftar ke barabar raftar se har simt phailte hain. Baad ke waqt naya wavefront tamam secondary wavelets ko chhooti satah hai, jise un ka envelope kehte hain.

Fig 15.2 mein wavefront AB source S se bahar ki taraf chalta hai. Waqt t ke baad us ki shakal maloom karne ke liye farz karein ke lehar ki raftar v har jagah aik hai, is liye waqt t mein lehar vt faasla tay karti hai. AB ke nuqton par markaz rakh kar vt radius ke daire (spherical wavelets ke nishan) banayein. In wavelets ka envelope, curve CD, naya wavefront hai. Huygens ke usool ke tamam nataij Maxwell ki equations se bhi nikalte hain, lekin Huygens ka saada model use karna aasan hai.

blocks.alt: Baen taraf source S aur us ke daen kham-daar primary wavefront AB jis par saat nuqte hain. Har nuqte se radius vt ka secondary wavelet bana hai; aik gulabi lakeer aik radius dikhati hai aur vt wala teer harkat ki simt. Tamam wavelets ko chhoti hui lakeer CD secondary wavefront hai; aik chhoti qaus par wavelet likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.2: Pichhle wavefront se naye wavefront ka banna (kitab ki Figure 15.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki figure mein primary wavefront ke oopar wale sire par 'S' aur teer par 'yt' chhapa hai. Matan (text) ke mutabiq yeh A aur vt hain: wavefront AB hai aur har wavelet ka radius vt hai (raftar v guna waqt t). Khaake mein A aur vt likha hai. Naya wavefront CD tamam wavelets ko chhoone wali lakeer (envelope) hai.

blocks.prompt: Kya Huygens ka usool awaz aur pani ki lehron par laagu ho sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Haan. Yeh muqarrara raftar se chalne wali har lehar par laagu hai, is liye awaz aur pani ki lehron ka phailna aur murna bhi roshni ki tarah samjhata hai.

items: Wavefront ka har nuqta secondary wavelets ka source.
Naya wavefront = waqt t ke baad wavelets (radius vt) ka envelope.
